title: Pelican Reckon
style: Aussie pub-rock with a loose swung beat, stomping kick and handclaps, verse rides dry banter over guitar stabs, pre-chorus strips to bass and shouted replies, chorus hits with gang vocals on the anchor phrase, a cheeky whistle tag and crowd-chant ad-libs, bright dusty mix with sunburnt pub energy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Slab on ice, mate
Snags on the plate
I’m talkin’ big smoke
At a backyard rate

Brolly in the chair
Flip-flops in the dirt
Auntie’s got the sauce
And the esky’s got it worked

[Pre-Chorus]
You roll up late
Still lookin’ fresh
Mum says, “grab a plate”
Then the whole thing’s best

[Chorus]
Aussie bbq, what’s the pelican reckon?
(what’s the pelican reckon?)
West coast slang and the whole yard’s beckonin’
(whole yard’s beckonin’)

Aussie bbq, keep the vibe real good
(keep it real good)
One more snag, one more laugh, that’s understood
(that’s understood)

[Verse 2]
Cousin’s on the deck
Talkin’ footy and waves
Said “how ya goin’, legend?”
Then he wandered away

Cold cans in the shade
Bare feet on the pavers
Everyone’s a mate here
Even the loud neighbors

[Pre-Chorus]
You hear that grin
In every line
Half the words are jokes
The other half is fine

[Chorus]
Aussie bbq, what’s the pelican reckon?
(what’s the pelican reckon?)
West coast slang and the whole yard’s beckonin’
(whole yard’s beckonin’)

Aussie bbq, keep the vibe real good
(keep it real good)
One more snag, one more laugh, that’s understood
(that’s understood)

[Bridge]
Say “no worries”
Say it twice
Pass the sauce around
Let the good times rise

From the coast to the yard
It all comes clear
If the pelican’s keen
We’re staying right here

[Final Chorus]
Aussie bbq, what’s the pelican reckon?
(what’s the pelican reckon?)
West coast slang and the whole yard’s beckonin’
(whole yard’s beckonin’)

Aussie bbq, keep the vibe real good
(keep it real good)
One more snag, one more laugh, that’s understood
(that’s understood)
